subject.title: feat: add relyable scanner adapter (functional re-derivation evidence)

question: Should ClawScan include `relyable` as a built-in Docker-installed scanner despite its execution-capable functional-rederivation workflow and external Git-sourced runtime dependency?
rationale: The code follows the existing adapter shape, but accepting this new scanner category determines the public scanner catalog, default runtime contents, and security boundary; that intent cannot be inferred from tests alone.

options.title: Sponsor the built-in scanner
options.body: Accept this scanner category and dependency boundary, then refresh the branch against current `main` and review the resulting merge plus runtime image changes.

options.title: Keep it external for now
options.body: Do not add the default runtime dependency and instead revisit a profile, external adapter, or benchmark proposal when maintainers have a supported product direction.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the built-in scanner
recommendation.body: Accept this scanner category and dependency boundary, then refresh the branch against current `main` and review the resulting merge plus runtime image changes.
